packages.section: Game-boy's playtest note in this brief (the Punk's hands in the guard), within Part A A5 and A20
packages.note: THE FAULT. In the Punk's fighting guard at 1 m (C2 'Look: Punk body at 1 m', frame 109; the lead's crop: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-arachne-repos-beat-em-up-PoC/097d610a-a8fb-4633-bbe9-6486aed195e7/scratchpad/guard_hands.png) the viewer sees the PALM side of each fist: the curled fingers face outward toward the player, and the thumbs sit on the OUTSIDE of each fist. In a boxer's guard the fingers curl back toward his own face (the viewer sees the back of the hand and the knuckle ridge) and the thumbs sit on the inside, near the face. M3's box fists were symmetric, so no test or review ever saw which way a hand faced. STEP 1, DIAGNOSE before changing anything, with numbers: (a) on the shipped punk.glb at rest, which way each fist's palm, back and thumb point in the hand bone's frame, against A5 (palm to the midline, thumb to -Z) and pipe_fist.py's header (a LEFT fist, back of the hand to the character's left; the right one mirrored in x); (b) in the guard pose the game plays (the enemy boxer guard; find the clip in game/actors/placeholder_poses.gd / enemy_named_poses.gd), which way the palm normal and thumb point in the camera's frame at C2's frame 109. Decide from that whether the fault is the fist piece (it breaks A5) or the pose's forearm/hand roll (the piece meets A5 and the guard rolls it palm-forward). STEP 2, FIX the root cause. If it's the piece: correct its orientation in pipe_fist.py / pipeline.json, rebuild the four Punk GLBs (punk, punk_rest, punk_auto, punk_auto_rest), and add a contract test that fails on today's GLB (palm and thumb direction per hand at rest). If it's the pose: re-roll the hand (and the forearm only if needed) in the enemy guard clip and any other enemy clip where the same fault shows, so the fingers curl toward the face and the thumbs sit inside. That is a departure from A20's frozen-clip list, the lead's call (log it as call 27 in your calls file; the lead copies it to M4-judgement-calls.md). Keep every FistPoint within A20's 1 cm, regenerate tests/fixtures/motion/move_clip_hashes.json with gen_clip_hashes.tscn with a reason note as call 24 did, and re-run the hit, reach, readability and ragdoll tests. Either way add a test that pins the guard's hand orientation (the palm faces the body's own face or midline, the thumb points toward the midline) so it can't regress. STEP 3, CHECK EVERY VIEW of the Punk's hands at 1 m in first person, beside concept A (assets/source/concepts/punk_a_denim_vest.jpg): the guard (C1, C2), the jab, cross and shove (C4: a jab and cross land knuckles first, palm down or turned in; a shove pushes palms forward, which is right for a shove), the reacts (C5), the hold (C11), the hanging rest and the walk (C3, C10: palm toward the thigh). Make before/after full-resolution crops of each. STEP 4, THE HERO: check Hero C's own fists in first person ('Look: my arms and legs': the guard, the strikes, the hold) for the same fault. Change them only if they show it, and say which. You own: tools/pipeline/pipe_fist.py, the fist keys of assets/source/characters/punk/pipeline.json, assets/*/characters/punk/**, the enemy guard and strike poses in game/actors/placeholder_poses.gd and game/actors/enemy_named_poses.gd (hand and forearm rolls only), tests/fixtures/motion/move_clip_hashes.json, tests/test_art_contract.gd and tests/test_art_punk.gd (new tests and the Punk rows), tests/test_motion_m4.gd (a new guard-orientation test), ratchet figures your rebuild moves in tests/test_m4_done_when.gd, tests/fixtures/strain/strain_ratchet.json and tests/fixtures/motion/m3_deformation.json (regenerate with their gen_*.tscn, old -> new), ASSETS.md's Punk rows, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's F-punk heading, and your calls file. THEN: the chain checks if you rebuilt (docs/milestones/M4-plan.md A22: the Punk, the probe, the hero and the heat-map --check), the full suite (green, 0 SCRIPT ERROR, SHADER ERROR or ERROR), and re-record C2, C4 and C11 one act per process. Done: in the guard at 1 m the Punk's curled fingers face his own face and his thumbs sit on the inside, every other view of his hands is right or better than before, and the before/after crops show it.
